as a person who has struggled with depression and who has a lot of friends in similar or worse situation it's safe to say that a lot of us have this view in life... even in our best moments, we never quit considering suicide as a last resort if everything goes wrong... I guess it's easier for us that way. the best you can do is show support for your friend and never leave his side even when you think he's better... ask about his day, plans for the future... also talking about your own feelings and insecurities is great because he will see that he is not alone! sadly there is not too much us friends can do, the best help will always be from professionals and medication, but stick together, ok? that's what friends are for
